### Tradeoffs and Analysis (Separating Facts from Subjective GOAT Claims)
* **Accolade Volume & Peak Honors (Factual):** In terms of regular-season defensive accolades, Jordan holds a clear advantage with nine 1st-Team selections and a Defensive Player of the Year award [jordan_accolades_240]. James earned six total All-Defensive honors (five 1st Team, one 2nd Team) and zero DPOYs [lebron_accolades_320].
* **Context & Subjectivity:** While Jordan's formal defensive award counts are higher, subjective debates often contrast accolade totals with impact metrics and role context. The provided text notes that Jordan had strong defensive plus-minus metrics for a wing, though his defense did not move the needle like a rim-protecting big man [jordan_defense_3840], while James is characterized as an elite perimeter defender whose team-dependency can influence on/off impact measures [lebron_defense_4080, lebron_defense_0].
